typography_systems.Name: Warm Graphic Novella
typography_systems.Display Typography: Soft literary serif, 36–56 pt, bold, hand-set vector only
typography_systems.Heading Typography: Warm serif or rounded display serif, 18–28 pt
typography_systems.Caption/Notes Typography: Small serif/sans mix, 8–9.5 pt, cream caption boxes
typography_systems.Production Rules: Use for emotional Indian story pages; keep titles quiet and premium; never allow AI-rendered final text.
typography_systems.Notes: Use as vector typography after image generation.

typography_systems.Name: Mythic Epic Caption
typography_systems.Display Typography: Tall carved serif / inscription-inspired display, 40–64 pt
typography_systems.Heading Typography: Small caps serif, 16–24 pt with generous tracking
typography_systems.Body Typography: Readable book serif or clean sans, 10–11 pt
typography_systems.Production Rules: Use for gods, warriors, vimanas, sacred reveals; pair type with ornamental plaques but keep text zones blank in image generation.
typography_systems.Notes: Use as vector typography after image generation.

typography_systems.Name: Detective Notebook Comic
typography_systems.Production Rules: Best for clue pages, mystery, school adventures; typography sits on notes/tape labels, never over faces.
typography_systems.Notes: Use as vector typography after image generation.

typography_systems.Name: Action Motion Comic
typography_systems.Display Typography: Compressed bold display, 42–72 pt for chapter/action beats
typography_systems.SFX/Icon Typography: Large hand-drawn SFX integrated with motion direction
typography_systems.Production Rules: Use strong hierarchy but only 1–2 SFX per page; gutters must stay clean and readable.
typography_systems.Notes: Use as vector typography after image generation.

typography_systems.Name: Silent Poetic Comic
typography_systems.Display Typography: Minimal serif title, 28–42 pt only if needed
typography_systems.SFX/Icon Typography: No SFX or one tiny environmental mark
typography_systems.Production Rules: For silent pages, emotional beats, reveals, sacred moments; protect negative space and visual pacing.
typography_systems.Notes: Use as vector typography after image generation.

typography_systems.Name: Children Humour Comic
typography_systems.Production Rules: Use for jokes and expressions; typography can be lively but must not crowd art.
typography_systems.Notes: Use as vector typography after image generation.

typography_systems.Name: Heritage Scroll Comic
typography_systems.Display Typography: Decorative serif inspired by manuscript title plates, 34–56 pt
typography_systems.Heading Typography: Small-caps serif on scroll tabs, 14–22 pt
typography_systems.SFX/Icon Typography: Tiny ornamental marks, not modern SFX-heavy
typography_systems.Production Rules: Use for Kalamkari, Pattachitra, palm-leaf, temple processions; keep reading order clearly numbered/flowed.
typography_systems.Notes: Use as vector typography after image generation.

typography_systems.Name: Modern Vertical Webcomic
typography_systems.Production Rules: Use for phone-friendly scroll pages; large spacing between beats; avoid tiny text.
typography_systems.Notes: Use as vector typography after image generation.

typography_systems.Name: Manuscript Border Comic
typography_systems.Display Typography: Elegant serif in framed plaque, 32–52 pt
typography_systems.Body Typography: Book serif or calm sans, 9–10.5 pt
typography_systems.Caption/Notes Typography: Border plaques and corner notes, 8–9.5 pt
typography_systems.Production Rules: Main story remains inside frame; border micro-panels must not compete with main panel.
typography_systems.Notes: Use as vector typography after image generation.

typography_systems.Name: Cinematic Poster Comic
typography_systems.SFX/Icon Typography: Almost none; let cinema mood lead
typography_systems.Production Rules: Use for opening, chapter breaks and finales; one hero image leads everything.
typography_systems.Notes: Use as vector typography after image generation.

typography_systems.Name: Field Guide Editorial
typography_systems.SFX/Icon Typography: No SFX; use icons and labels
typography_systems.Production Rules: Great for creatures, animals, plants, objects; use labels as vector overlay after generation.
typography_systems.Notes: Use as vector typography after image generation.

typography_systems.Name: Mythic Sketchbook Editorial
typography_systems.Production Rules: Use for ideation, mythology research and studio dossiers; note zones must look designed, not messy.
typography_systems.Notes: Use as vector typography after image generation.

typography_systems.Name: Activity Workbook
typography_systems.SFX/Icon Typography: Small playful icons, stars, check marks
typography_systems.Production Rules: Use for kids activities, puzzles, worksheets; leave answer boxes and instruction areas clean.
typography_systems.Notes: Use as vector typography after image generation.

typography_systems.Name: Map Quest Editorial
typography_systems.SFX/Icon Typography: Directional arrows, route dots, compass icons
typography_systems.Production Rules: Use for maps, city quests, treasure routes; text never sits on dense map details.
typography_systems.Notes: Use as vector typography after image generation.

typography_systems.Name: Sacred Archive
typography_systems.Production Rules: Use for historical/mythic dossiers; typography should feel premium, quiet and collectible.
typography_systems.Notes: Use as vector typography after image generation.

typography_systems.Name: Modern Premium Editorial
typography_systems.Production Rules: Use for polished magazine covers, features and brand-quality spreads.
typography_systems.Notes: Use as vector typography after image generation.

typography_systems.Name: Infographic Lab
typography_systems.Production Rules: Use for diagrams, anatomy, timelines; hierarchy must be strict and readable.
typography_systems.Notes: Use as vector typography after image generation.

typography_systems.Name: Sticker Asset Board

typography_systems.Name: Craft / Recipe Page
